title: Align Rust gateway key rotation with canonical replay-safe transcript
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs still signs and verifies legacy KEY_ROTATE: || new_pubkey messages. The canonical protocol requires LICHEN-KEY-ROTATION-v1 || 0x00 || old_pubkey || old_key_derived_iid || new_pubkey || rotation_sequence_be64, with a strictly increasing nonzero persisted rotation sequence. PinnedGateway and persistence currently carry no rotation sequence, so a previously valid rotation authorization can be replayed and Rust is not interoperable with the current spec/Python implementation. Update the API, transcript, durable state, and canonical vectors/tests together.
close_reason: Verified prior transcript/sequence work against Python oracle; closed remaining parity gaps: IID now derived internally in rotation transcript (spec 8.7), same-key rotation rejected (UnchangedRotationKey), v1->v2 migration test added. 43 trust tests pass; full gateway suite green except pre-existing bead-owned tunnel_auth failure.
